description: Drilldown for the Claude Prompts dashboard: prompt usage per repository, user, model and mode, with the same filters.

links.title: Claude Prompts
links.tooltip: Back to the Claude Prompts dashboard

panels.description: Prompts, sessions, cost and average input, output, cache read and cache write tokens per prompt for each repository the prompt ran in, from the origin remote Claude Code reports, split by user, the model or combination of models the prompt used, and permission mode. Share is of all prompts shown. Repository 'Unknown' means the session had no origin remote or the client did not report one. Model 'N/A' means the prompt made no model request, such as a local slash command. Project is the DevLake project that also collects the repository, 'Unmapped' when none does, or 'No repository' for prompts without one. Skills lists the distinct skills those prompts used, and is empty when none did. Repositories show as GH:, GL: or BB: (GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket, cloud or self-hosted) followed by their path; other hosts show their host name.

targets.rawSql:
-- base is every prompt the panel counts.
WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.workspace_key, p.session_id, p.prompt_id, p.repository_url,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    -- Grouping on the raw columns keeps the sort keys narrow; the labels are applied once per row at the end.
    p.models_used, p.permission_mode,
    NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '') AS full_name,
    p.estimated_cost_usd, p.input_tokens, p.output_tokens, p.cache_read_tokens, p.cache_creation_tokens, p.used_skill
  FROM ai_prompts p
  -- account_id is the user's DevLake account, whose full_name the plugin copies from
  -- another account with the same email.
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
), prompt_rows AS (
  -- A prompt row carries the prompt's metrics, and a skill row only a skill name, so one
  -- grouping gives both without joining skills to the metrics: the aggregates skip NULLs.
  SELECT repository_url, user, models_used, permission_mode, full_name, 1 AS prompt, session_id,
    estimated_cost_usd, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, used_skill, NULL AS skill_name
  FROM base
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.repository_url, b.user, b.models_used, b.permission_mode, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, s.skill_name
  FROM base b
  JOIN ai_prompt_skills s ON s.workspace_key = b.workspace_key AND s.session_id = b.session_id AND s.prompt_id = b.prompt_id
), r AS (
  SELECT repository_url, user, models_used, permission_mode,
    MAX(full_name) AS full_name,
    COUNT(prompt) AS prompts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions,
    SUM(estimated_cost_usd) AS cost,
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    SUM(cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read_tokens,
    SUM(cache_creation_tokens) AS cache_creation_tokens,
    AVG(used_skill) AS skill_share,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT skill_name ORDER BY skill_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS skills
  FROM prompt_rows
  GROUP BY repository_url, user, models_used, permission_mode
)
SELECT CASE
    WHEN r.repository_url IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?github[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GH: ')
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?gitlab[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GL: ')
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://(www[.])?bitbucket[.]org/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'BB: ')
    -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', 'BB: ')
    ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(r.repository_url, '^https?://', '')
  END AS "Repository",
  CASE WHEN r.repository_url IS NULL THEN 'No repository' ELSE COALESCE(dl.projects, 'Unmapped') END AS "Project",
  COALESCE(r.full_name, r.user) AS "User",
  CASE WHEN r.models_used = '' THEN 'N/A' ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(r.models_used, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 'opus ', 'Opus '), 'sonnet ', 'Sonnet '), 'haiku ', 'Haiku '), 'fable ', 'Fable '), ',', ', ') END AS "Model",
  CASE r.permission_mode WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' ELSE r.permission_mode END AS "Mode",
  r.prompts AS "Prompts",
  r.prompts / SUM(r.prompts) OVER () AS "Share",
  r.sessions AS "Sessions",
  r.cost AS "Cost",
  r.cost / r.prompts AS "Cost per prompt",
  r.input_tokens / r.prompts AS "Input Tokens per Prompt",
  r.output_tokens / r.prompts AS "Output Tokens per Prompt",
  r.cache_read_tokens / r.prompts AS "Cache Read Tokens per Prompt",
  r.cache_creation_tokens / r.prompts AS "Cache Write Tokens per Prompt",
  r.skill_share AS "Skill Usage",
  COALESCE(r.skills, '') AS "Skills",
  -- repository_link is empty for prompts without a repository, so their Repository cell has no link.
  COALESCE(r.repository_url, '') AS repository_link
FROM r
LEFT JOIN (
  -- repository_url is lowercased with the .git suffix dropped, so normalize repos.url the same way.
  SELECT TRIM(TRAILING '.git' FROM LOWER(rp.url)) AS url,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pm.project_name ORDER BY pm.project_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS projects
  FROM repos rp
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = rp.id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
  GROUP BY TRIM(TRAILING '.git' FROM LOWER(rp.url))
) dl ON dl.url = r.repository_url
ORDER BY r.repository_url IS NULL, 1, 3, r.prompts DESC

panels.title: Prompt Usage by Repository

panels.description: Per-user prompt volume, cost and habits, split by the model or combination of models the prompt used, its reasoning effort and its permission mode. Model and effort 'N/A' mean the prompt made no model request, such as a local slash command, or the client sent no effort.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(u.full_name, u.user) AS "User",
  u.team AS "Team",
  u.model AS "Model",
  u.effort AS "Effort",
  u.mode AS "Mode",
  u.prompts AS "Prompts",
  u.sessions AS "Sessions",
  u.cost AS "Cost",
  u.cost / u.prompts AS "Cost per prompt",
  u.skill_share AS "Used a skill",
  u.command_share AS "Slash command",
  u.tool_failure_rate AS "Tool failure rate"
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    CASE WHEN p.models_used = '' THEN 'N/A' ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(p.models_used, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 'opus ', 'Opus '), 'sonnet ', 'Sonnet '), 'haiku ', 'Haiku '), 'fable ', 'Fable '), ',', ', ') END AS model,
    CASE p.effort WHEN 'low' THEN 'Low' WHEN 'medium' THEN 'Medium' WHEN 'high' THEN 'High' WHEN 'xhigh' THEN 'XHigh' WHEN 'max' THEN 'Max' ELSE COALESCE(CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(p.effort, 1)), SUBSTRING(p.effort, 2)), 'N/A') END AS effort,
    CASE p.permission_mode WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' ELSE p.permission_mode END AS mode,
    MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '')) AS full_name,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.team_slug ORDER BY c.team_slug SEPARATOR ', ') AS team,
    COUNT(*) AS prompts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.session_id) AS sessions,
    SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) AS cost,
    AVG(p.used_skill) AS skill_share,
    AVG(p.command_name <> '') AS command_share,
    COALESCE(SUM(p.tool_failure_count) / NULLIF(SUM(p.tool_call_count), 0), 0) AS tool_failure_rate
  FROM ai_prompts p
  LEFT JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = p.source_connection_id
  -- account_id is the user's DevLake account, whose full_name the plugin copies from
  -- another account with the same email.
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
) u
ORDER BY 1, u.prompts DESC

panels.title: Prompt Usage by User

panels.description: Input, output, cache read and cache write tokens per repository and user. Repositories carry the labels from Token Usage by Repository on Claude Prompts, and a repository's rows add up to that chart's bar. GH, GL and BB stand for GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket, cloud or self-hosted; other hosts show their host name. Repository 'Unknown' means the session had no origin remote or the client did not report one. Project is the DevLake project that also collects the repository, 'Unmapped' when none does, or 'No repository' for prompts without one. User is the person's full name from their DevLake account, or their email when it has none. Click a repository to open it in a new tab.

targets.rawSql:
-- base sums every prompt the panel counts per repository URL and user; the labels are applied once per row.
WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.repository_url AS url,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    -- account_id is the user's DevLake account, whose full_name the plugin copies from
    -- another account with the same email.
    MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '')) AS full_name,
    SUM(p.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(p.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    SUM(p.cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read_tokens,
    SUM(p.cache_creation_tokens) AS cache_creation_tokens
  FROM ai_prompts p
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY p.repository_url, 2
)
-- The Repository label is the one Token Usage by Repository on Claude Prompts uses, so a bar's rows carry its label.
SELECT CASE
    WHEN b.url IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN b.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?github[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(b.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GH: ')
    WHEN b.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?gitlab[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(b.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GL: ')
    WHEN b.url REGEXP '^https?://(www[.])?bitbucket[.]org/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(b.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'BB: ')
    -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
    WHEN b.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(b.url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', 'BB: ')
    ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(b.url, '^https?://', '')
  END AS "Repository",
  CASE WHEN b.url IS NULL THEN 'No repository' ELSE COALESCE(dl.projects, 'Unmapped') END AS "Project",
  COALESCE(b.full_name, b.user) AS "User",
  b.input_tokens AS "Input",
  b.output_tokens AS "Output",
  b.cache_read_tokens AS "Cache read",
  b.cache_creation_tokens AS "Cache write",
  -- repository_link is empty for prompts without a repository, so their Repository cell has no link.
  COALESCE(b.url, '') AS repository_link
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN (
  -- repository_url is lowercased with the .git suffix dropped, so normalize repos.url the same way.
  SELECT TRIM(TRAILING '.git' FROM LOWER(rp.url)) AS url,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pm.project_name ORDER BY pm.project_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS projects
  FROM repos rp
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = rp.id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
  GROUP BY TRIM(TRAILING '.git' FROM LOWER(rp.url))
) dl ON dl.url = b.url
ORDER BY b.url IS NULL, 1, b.input_tokens + b.output_tokens + b.cache_read_tokens + b.cache_creation_tokens DESC

panels.title: Token Usage by Repository and User

panels.description: Failed tool calls (tool_result with success=false) in the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Tool failures"
FROM ai_prompt_failures f
JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = f.ai_prompt_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  AND f.failure_kind = 'tool_error'

panels.title: Tool Failures

panels.description: Model requests that returned an api_error.

targets.rawSql:

FROM ai_prompt_failures f
JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = f.ai_prompt_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})

panels.title: API Errors

panels.description: Share of the prompts active in the time range (started in it, or had a failure in it) with at least one API error or failed tool call. Failures count by when they happened, like the other failure panels.

targets.rawSql:
-- Failures count by when they happened, like the other failure panels. The share is of the
-- prompts active in the range: those that started in it or had a failure in it. The two halves
-- of the UNION each use their own time index; an OR across the two tables would scan every prompt.
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.failed) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS "Prompts with a failure"
FROM (
  SELECT u.id, MAX(u.failed) AS failed
  FROM (
    SELECT p.id, 0 AS failed FROM ai_prompts p WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT f.ai_prompt_id, 1 FROM ai_prompt_failures f WHERE $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at)
  ) u
  GROUP BY u.id
) a
JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = a.id
WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})

panels.title: Failed Prompts

panels.description: The most frequent failure reason and its count: the tool and error type for tool failures, and for API errors the HTTP status, or when the request got no status (such as a timeout) the start of its error message, without request ids.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.reason AS "Top failure reason"
FROM (
  SELECT CASE f.failure_kind WHEN 'api_error' THEN CONCAT('API ', COALESCE(CONCAT(f.status_code, ' ', CASE f.status_code WHEN 400 THEN 'Bad request' WHEN 401 THEN 'Unauthorized' WHEN 403 THEN 'Forbidden' WHEN 404 THEN 'Not found' WHEN 413 THEN 'Request too large' WHEN 429 THEN 'Rate limited' WHEN 500 THEN 'Server error' WHEN 503 THEN 'Unavailable' WHEN 529 THEN 'Overloaded' ELSE 'Error' END), NULLIF(f.error_type, ''), NULLIF(TRIM(LEFT(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.error_message, 'req_[A-Za-z0-9]+', '')), 60)), ''), 'Unknown')) ELSE CONCAT(f.tool_name, ' · ', COALESCE(NULLIF(f.error_type, ''), 'Unknown')) END AS reason, COUNT(*) AS failures
  FROM ai_prompt_failures f
  JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = f.ai_prompt_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY failures DESC, reason
  LIMIT 1
) r

panels.title: Top Failure

panels.description: The most frequent API error and its count. Errors are grouped by HTTP status, or, when the request got no status (such as a timeout), by the start of the error message without request ids. 429 is a rate limit, 529 an overloaded service. The messages are in Top Failure Reasons.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.label AS "Top API error"
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(CONCAT(f.status_code, ' ', CASE f.status_code WHEN 400 THEN 'Bad request' WHEN 401 THEN 'Unauthorized' WHEN 403 THEN 'Forbidden' WHEN 404 THEN 'Not found' WHEN 413 THEN 'Request too large' WHEN 429 THEN 'Rate limited' WHEN 500 THEN 'Server error' WHEN 503 THEN 'Unavailable' WHEN 529 THEN 'Overloaded' ELSE 'Error' END), NULLIF(f.error_type, ''), NULLIF(TRIM(LEFT(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.error_message, 'req_[A-Za-z0-9]+', '')), 60)), ''), 'Unknown') AS label,
    COUNT(*) AS errors
  FROM ai_prompt_failures f
  JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = f.ai_prompt_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
    AND f.failure_kind = 'api_error'
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY errors DESC, label
  LIMIT 1
) r

panels.title: Top API Error

panels.description: Failures per UTC day, stacked by reason. API errors are grouped by HTTP status, or by the start of the error message when the request got no status; tool failures by tool and error type.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(f.occurred_at)) AS time,
  CASE f.failure_kind WHEN 'api_error' THEN CONCAT('API ', COALESCE(CONCAT(f.status_code, ' ', CASE f.status_code WHEN 400 THEN 'Bad request' WHEN 401 THEN 'Unauthorized' WHEN 403 THEN 'Forbidden' WHEN 404 THEN 'Not found' WHEN 413 THEN 'Request too large' WHEN 429 THEN 'Rate limited' WHEN 500 THEN 'Server error' WHEN 503 THEN 'Unavailable' WHEN 529 THEN 'Overloaded' ELSE 'Error' END), NULLIF(f.error_type, ''), NULLIF(TRIM(LEFT(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.error_message, 'req_[A-Za-z0-9]+', '')), 60)), ''), 'Unknown')) ELSE CONCAT(f.tool_name, ' · ', COALESCE(NULLIF(f.error_type, ''), 'Unknown')) END AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM ai_prompt_failures f
JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = f.ai_prompt_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Failures per Day by Reason

panels.description: Every failure reason, by kind, tool or model and error, with how often it happened, how many prompts and users it hit, and when it last happened. Error is the HTTP status for API errors, or the start of the error message, without request ids, when there is none; for tool failures it is the error type. Example message is one API error's message for the reason; Recent Failures lists each one. Tool failures have none, because a tool's error message can echo file contents and is never stored.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE f.failure_kind WHEN 'api_error' THEN 'API' ELSE 'Tool' END AS "Kind",
  CASE f.failure_kind WHEN 'api_error' THEN CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.model, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 1)), SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.model, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 2)) ELSE f.tool_name END AS "Tool / Model",
  CASE f.failure_kind WHEN 'api_error' THEN COALESCE(CONCAT(f.status_code, ' ', CASE f.status_code WHEN 400 THEN 'Bad request' WHEN 401 THEN 'Unauthorized' WHEN 403 THEN 'Forbidden' WHEN 404 THEN 'Not found' WHEN 413 THEN 'Request too large' WHEN 429 THEN 'Rate limited' WHEN 500 THEN 'Server error' WHEN 503 THEN 'Unavailable' WHEN 529 THEN 'Overloaded' ELSE 'Error' END), NULLIF(f.error_type, ''), NULLIF(TRIM(LEFT(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.error_message, 'req_[A-Za-z0-9]+', '')), 60)), ''), 'Unknown') ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(f.error_type, ''), 'Unknown') END AS "Error",
  -- Messages can carry request ids, so one example stands in for the reason's messages.
  MAX(NULLIF(f.error_message, '')) AS "Example message",
  COUNT(*) AS "Failures",
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.ai_prompt_id) AS "Prompts",
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key)) AS "Users",
  MAX(f.occurred_at) AS "Last seen"
FROM ai_prompt_failures f
JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = f.ai_prompt_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 5 DESC, 1, 2, 3

panels.title: Top Failure Reasons

panels.description: API errors by HTTP status, model and where the request came from: the main conversation, a subagent or background work such as session titles. Attempt is the retry attempt that failed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(CAST(f.status_code AS CHAR), 'N/A') AS "Status",
  CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.model, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 1)), SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.model, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 2)) AS "Model",
  CASE WHEN f.failure_kind <> 'api_error' THEN '' WHEN f.query_source = 'repl_main_thread' THEN 'Main conversation' WHEN f.query_source LIKE 'agent:%' THEN CONCAT('Subagent (', SUBSTRING_INDEX(f.query_source, ':', -1), ')') WHEN f.query_source = '' THEN 'Unknown' ELSE CONCAT('Background (', f.query_source, ')') END AS "Source",
  COUNT(*) AS "Errors",
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.ai_prompt_id) AS "Prompts",
  AVG(f.attempt) AS "Avg attempt",
  MAX(f.attempt) AS "Max attempt",
  MAX(f.occurred_at) AS "Last seen"
FROM ai_prompt_failures f
JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = f.ai_prompt_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  AND f.failure_kind = 'api_error'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 4 DESC, 1, 2, 3

panels.title: API Errors by Status and Model

panels.description: The latest 200 failures in the time range, newest first. Repositories show as GH:, GL: or BB: (GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket, cloud or self-hosted) followed by their path; other hosts show their host name.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT f.occurred_at AS "Time",
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''), NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS "User",
  CASE
    WHEN p.repository_url IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN p.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?github[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(p.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GH: ')
    WHEN p.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?gitlab[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(p.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GL: ')
    WHEN p.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://(www[.])?bitbucket[.]org/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(p.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'BB: ')
    -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
    WHEN p.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(p.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', 'BB: ')
    ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(p.repository_url, '^https?://', '')
  END AS "Repository",
  CASE f.failure_kind WHEN 'api_error' THEN 'API' ELSE 'Tool' END AS "Kind",
  CASE f.failure_kind WHEN 'api_error' THEN CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.model, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 1)), SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.model, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 2)) ELSE f.tool_name END AS "Tool / Model",
  CASE f.failure_kind WHEN 'api_error' THEN COALESCE(CONCAT(f.status_code, ' ', CASE f.status_code WHEN 400 THEN 'Bad request' WHEN 401 THEN 'Unauthorized' WHEN 403 THEN 'Forbidden' WHEN 404 THEN 'Not found' WHEN 413 THEN 'Request too large' WHEN 429 THEN 'Rate limited' WHEN 500 THEN 'Server error' WHEN 503 THEN 'Unavailable' WHEN 529 THEN 'Overloaded' ELSE 'Error' END), NULLIF(f.error_type, ''), NULLIF(TRIM(LEFT(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.error_message, 'req_[A-Za-z0-9]+', '')), 60)), ''), 'Unknown') ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(f.error_type, ''), 'Unknown') END AS "Error",
  NULLIF(f.error_message, '') AS "Message",
  CASE WHEN f.failure_kind <> 'api_error' THEN '' WHEN f.query_source = 'repl_main_thread' THEN 'Main conversation' WHEN f.query_source LIKE 'agent:%' THEN CONCAT('Subagent (', SUBSTRING_INDEX(f.query_source, ':', -1), ')') WHEN f.query_source = '' THEN 'Unknown' ELSE CONCAT('Background (', f.query_source, ')') END AS "Source",
  f.duration_ms AS "Duration",
  -- repository_link is empty for prompts without a repository, so their Repository cell has no link.
  COALESCE(p.repository_url, '') AS repository_link
FROM ai_prompt_failures f
JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = f.ai_prompt_id
-- account_id is the user's DevLake account, which carries the full name.
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
ORDER BY f.occurred_at DESC
LIMIT 200

FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '')) AS full_name
  FROM ai_prompts p
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id

) u
ORDER BY 1;
